companies.name: Stafford Bros & Draeger
companies.distributes: Biscuits (Walkers Scottish Shortbread), jams and preserves (Mackays marmalades and curds), snacks and dips (Bandito's), Ryvita crispbread, Twinings tea and Ovaltine; its portfolio covers dry groceries, confectionery, biscuits and hot and cold beverages.
companies.channels_supplied: All major South African supermarket chains, independent retailers, cash and carries, wholesalers and food service across Southern Africa.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Ryvita crispbread (better-for-you); no sugar-free confectionery seen
companies.fit_rationale: A full-service importer and distributor of British branded packaged foods such as Walkers, Mackays, Twinings and Ryvita, selling them to the major chains, wholesalers and independents nationwide, which matches Diablo as a British brand of biscuits, spreads and sweets. Its regional and field sales managers already sell premium imported biscuits and preserves into the supermarket shelf. Scale: national distribution across South Africa including Cape Town and into neighbouring countries, supplying all major supermarket chains; trading since 1921; warehouse size, fleet and outlet count not shown on its website. Storage: products warehoused in Johannesburg and delivered nationwide through a warehousing and logistics partner.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1921 and long-time Southern African distributor of Twinings, Ovaltine and Walkers Scottish Shortbread.
Supplies all major South African supermarket chains plus independents, cash and carries and wholesalers nationally.
